# Full-blood Neanderthal and Jotnar men: always a big beard

	usage = game
	priority = 12
	selection_behavior = weighted_random
	neanderthal_male_beard_western_06 = {

			accessory = { mode = add gene = beards template = northern_beards_curly accessory = male_beard_western_06 }

				add = 40

# Auroran tattoos: stylised gears and mechanisms of the living ship-world (face and/or neck), on the side the person wears them

	usage = game

	selection_behavior = max

		}

			base = 0

				add = 100
				exists = this

				NOT = { portrait_has_trait_trigger = { TRAIT = full_cybernetic_conversion } }

				NOT = { has_character_flag = ck_tside_right }

# Aurorans live aboard ships: no hats unless in an army
ck_race_auroran_headgear = {
	usage = game
	priority = 12
	selection_behavior = max
	auroran_bareheaded = {
		ignore_outfit_tags = yes
		dna_modifiers = {
			accessory = { mode = add gene = headgear template = no_headgear range = { 0 1 } }
			accessory = { mode = add gene = secondary_headgears template = no_headgear range = { 0 1 } }
		}
		weight = {
			base = 0
			modifier = {
				add = 100
				exists = this
				ck_portrait_race_auroran_trigger = yes
				is_in_army = no
			}
		}
	}
}

# Hairless Aurorans (inherited outer-ring mutation): no hair, beard or eyebrows
ck_race_hairless = {
	usage = game
	priority = 12
	selection_behavior = max
	auroran_hairless = {
		ignore_outfit_tags = yes
		dna_modifiers = {
			accessory = { mode = add gene = hairstyles template = no_hairstyles range = { 0 1 } }
			accessory = { mode = add gene = beards template = no_beard range = { 0 1 } }
			morph = { mode = replace gene = gene_eyebrows_fullness template = no_eyebrows value = 0.5 }
			morph = { mode = replace gene = gene_eyebrows_shape template = no_eyebrows value = 0.5 }
		}
		weight = {
			base = 0
			modifier = {
				add = 200
				exists = this
				ck_portrait_race_auroran_trigger = yes
				has_character_flag = ck_hair_hairless
			}
		}
	}
}
